# 📖 Component Examples & Usage Guide

This guide provides practical examples for using and extending the website components.

## 🎯 JavaScript Component Examples

### 1. Code Block with Line Numbers

**HTML Setup**:
```html
<pre>
function helloWorld() {
    console.log("Hello, World!");
    return true;
}
</pre>
```

**Automatic Result** (generated by script.js):
```html
<pre class='lines'>1
2
3
4</pre>
<pre>
function helloWorld() {
    console.log("Hello, World!");
    return true;
}
</pre>
```

**Customization Options**:
```javascript
// Modify line wrap threshold (default: 70 characters)
var wrap = Math.floor(pre[i].split("").length / 80) // Custom: 80 chars

// Custom line number styling
.lines {
    color: #ff0000; /* Red line numbers */
    background: #f0f0f0; /* Light background */
}
```

---

### 2. Dynamic Navigation System

**Basic Usage**:
```html
<!-- Headers are automatically detected -->
<div class="markdown-body">
    <h1>Main Section</h1>
    <h2>Subsection 1</h2>
    <h2>Subsection 2</h2>
</div>
```

**Custom Navigation Trigger**:
```javascript
// Manual header collection
$(".custom-header").each(collectHeaders);

// Custom scroll behavior
$(window).scroll(function(){
    var customOffset = 25; // Custom offset
    if(scrolltop >= headings[i].top - customOffset) {
        $(".current-section .name").text(headings[i].text);
    }
});
```

**Advanced Configuration**:
```javascript
// Priority order customization
if($(".markdown-body h2").length > 1) {
    $(".markdown-body h2").each(collectHeaders) // Start with H2
} else if($(".markdown-body h3").length > 1) {
    $(".markdown-body h3").each(collectHeaders) // Fallback to H3
}
```

---

### 3. Scroll-to-Top Enhancement

**Basic Implementation**:
```html
<div class="current-section">
    <a href="#top">Scroll to top</a>
</div>
```

**Enhanced Version**:
```javascript
// Smooth scrolling instead of instant
$(".current-section a").click(function(){
    $('html, body').animate({
        scrollTop: 0
    }, 800); // 800ms smooth scroll
    return false;
});

// Add fade effect
$(window).scroll(function(){
    if($(window).scrollTop() > 300) {
        $(".current-section").fadeIn();
    } else {
        $(".current-section").fadeOut();
    }
});
```

### 3. Navigation Components

**Current Section Navigator**:
```html
<div class="current-section">
    <a href="#top">Scroll to top</a>
    <a href="download.zip" class="zip">zip</a>
```

**Custom Navigation Styles**:

```css
    top: 50%;
```

### 3. Interactive Elements

```javascript
// Add interactive features
$(document).ready(function(){
    // Highlight current section in navigation
    $('.nav-item').click(function(){
        $('.nav-item').removeClass('active');
        $(this).addClass('active');
    });
    
    // Add reading progress indicator
    $(window).scroll(function(){
        var scrollTop = $(window).scrollTop();
        var docHeight = $(document).height();
        var winHeight = $(window).height();
        var scrollPercent = (scrollTop) / (docHeight - winHeight);
        var scrollPercentRounded = Math.round(scrollPercent * 100);
        $('.progress-bar').css('width', scrollPercentRounded + '%');
    });
    
    // Lazy load images
    $('img[data-src]').each(function(){
        var img = $(this);
        img.attr('src', img.attr('data-src'));
        img.removeAttr('data-src');
    });
});
```

## 📱 Responsive Enhancements

### Mobile-Friendly Styles

```css
/* Mobile navigation */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .current-section {
        position: fixed;
        bottom: 0;
        left: 0;
        right: 0;

    }

        font-size: 36px;
        margin: 20px 10px;
    }
    
    .wrapper {
        width: 100%;
        padding: 0 15px;
    }
    
    #container {
        margin: 0 -15px;
    }
    
    .markdown-body pre {
        overflow-x: auto;
        font-size: 12px;
    }
}
```

### Touch-Friendly Interactions

```javascript
// Touch-friendly scroll detection
var touchStartY = 0;
$(document).on('touchstart', function(e) {
    touchStartY = e.originalEvent.touches[0].clientY;
});

$(document).on('touchend', function(e) {
    var touchEndY = e.originalEvent.changedTouches[0].clientY;
    var deltaY = touchStartY - touchEndY;
    
    if (Math.abs(deltaY) > 50) { // Minimum swipe distance
        if (deltaY > 0) {
            // Swipe up - scroll to next section
        } else {
            // Swipe down - scroll to previous section
        }
    }
});
```

## 🔍 Testing Examples

### Unit Tests for JavaScript Functions

```javascript
// Test line number generation
function testLineNumbers() {
    var testPre = $('<pre>line1\nline2\nline3</pre>');
    $('body').append(testPre);
    
    // Run line number script
    // Verify output
    var linesElement = testPre.prev('.lines');
    assert(linesElement.length === 1, 'Line numbers element should exist');
    assert(linesElement.text().includes('1\n2\n3'), 'Should contain line numbers');
    
    testPre.remove();
    linesElement.remove();
}

// Test navigation system
function testNavigation() {
    var testHeader = $('<h2>Test Header</h2>');
    $('.markdown-body').append(testHeader);
    
    // Simulate header collection
    headings = [];
    testHeader.each(collectHeaders);
    
    assert(headings.length === 1, 'Should collect one heading');
    assert(headings[0].text === 'Test Header', 'Should store header text');
    
    testHeader.remove();
}
```

### Performance Testing

```javascript
// Measure script execution time
var startTime = performance.now();

// Run initialization code
$(document).ready(function(){
    // Your code here
    
    var endTime = performance.now();
    console.log('Initialization took ' + (endTime - startTime) + ' milliseconds.');
});

// Memory usage monitoring
function checkMemoryUsage() {
    if (performance.memory) {
        console.log('Used memory: ' + performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize + ' bytes');
        console.log('Total memory: ' + performance.memory.totalJSHeapSize + ' bytes');
        console.log('Memory limit: ' + performance.memory.jsHeapSizeLimit + ' bytes');
    }
}
```
